questions.q: What kinds of transactions does RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL cover?
options: Invoices, debit memos, credit memos, commitments, and bills receivable, distinguished by a type column
Only supplier invoices
Only general ledger journal entries
Only standard invoices
questions.explain: Unlike AP_INVOICES_ALL, which only covers supplier invoices, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL is a single header table covering several Receivables transaction types.

questions.q: What does the LINE_TYPE column on RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL distinguish?
options: Which business unit owns the line
Whether a line represents the billed item (LINE), tax (TAX), or freight (FREIGHT), among others
Which supplier the line belongs to
The ledger currency
questions.explain: LINE_TYPE distinguishes different kinds of amounts within the same transaction, such as the billed goods/services, tax, and freight.

questions.q: What makes AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL different from how balances are typically tracked in Payables?
options: It is identical in structure to AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL
It doesn't track balances at all
It stores the remaining amount owed directly, updated whenever activity occurs, rather than requiring you to sum every receipt yourself
It only tracks Payables invoices
questions.explain: AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL carries the authoritative open balance directly and backs most AR aging reports.

questions.q: What does a receipt row in AR_CASH_RECEIPTS_ALL represent on its own, before any application?
options: A general ledger journal entry
A supplier payment
A fully reconciled, applied payment
Money that came in from a customer, not yet matched to any specific transaction
questions.explain: A cash receipt on its own just represents money received; the actual matching to transactions happens separately in AR_RECEIVABLE_APPLICATIONS_ALL.

questions.q: What does a status of UNID on an AR receivable application indicate?
options: Oracle doesn't yet know which customer the money belongs to
The transaction has been written off
The receipt was reversed
The receipt has been fully applied to a known transaction
questions.explain: UNID (unidentified) means the cash has not even been matched to a customer yet, distinct from UNAPP (known customer, but not matched to a transaction).
